literal: Duty they say good things all, duty knowing, perfect character to those who undertake.
translation: All good deeds are said to be the natural duty of those who, knowing their obligations, undertake to live a life of perfect character.
modern: தங்கள் கடமையை அறிந்து சான்றாண்மை என்னும் நற்பண்பை மேற்கொள்பவர்களுக்கு, நல்ல செயல்கள் யாவும் இயல்பான கடமை என்று கூறுவர்.
explanation: This couplet defines the mindset of those who strive for 'சான்றாண்மை' (perfect character or nobility). The word 'கடன்' is used twice with slightly different nuances: first as the general moral duty of doing good, and second as the specific awareness of one's obligations. For noble individuals who consciously choose a life of high character, performing every kind of good deed is not seen as an extraordinary favor to others, but simply as their natural, everyday duty.
